card.name: Linking words in checkpoint-inhibitor labels
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as for, of and with, plus the L in PD-L1, in immunotherapy labels (YERVOY, nivolumab, KEYTRUDA). They sit right before a disease, treatment or PD-L1 term.

modes.label: Linking word after nivolumab
modes.description: The word for or of follows a YERVOY with nivolumab dose and leads into the treatment of a cancer.
modes.example: 2.7% (15/666) of patients who received YERVOY 1 mg/kg with nivolumab<< for>> the treatment of RCC or mCRC,

card.writes: It pushes toward forms of the letters PD, as in PD-L1 or PD-1, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before cancer immunotherapy terms like PD-L1 in drug labels.
